stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Loto Interactive Limited delivers big data center solutions across China, Hong Kong, and Kazakhstan. Its business is structured into three main divisions: Big Data Centre Services within the People's Republic of China, Big Data Centre Services outside the PRC, and its Money Lending operations. Beyond its core data infrastructure offerings, the firm also engages in distributing online mobile games, provides specialized services such as data analytics and storage, and offers administrative and consulting support. Additionally, it maintains a money lending segment. Historically known as MelcoLot Limited, the company adopted its current name, Loto Interactive Limited, in September 2017. Headquartered in Hong Kong, as of July 25, 2022, it functions as a subsidiary of Manful Kingdom Limited.
